response.rationale: Both answers are accurate and natural for the stated service-order sense. Indonesian commonly uses “nomor antrean,” while Malaysian Malay uses “nombor giliran.” The forms are different common words, not false friends; “giliran” is broader and can mean a turn generally, but is valid here.
